paragraphs: R. Yaakov bar Abba, Rav's student. He interpreted it before Rav, Bava Metzia (41a). 'Rav Natan bar Abba interpreted it before Rav' (there)—perhaps he is his brother. 'R. Abba bar Yaakov said: R. Yoḥanan said'—perhaps he is his son.
